en: But true love and affection don't come from that.
I wanted you to know that the bond I feel with you is more than physical attraction. I genuinely care about you, as a man would a woman.
You opened your heart to me. And that's all that matters.
Oh no, my phone. This is really bad timing.
Hello? Oh, yes, ma'am. What is it?
What? Really!? Yeah... Uh-huh.
No way! How lucky am I?
All right! See you later!
What was that all about?
Do you remember that thing with Aimi-chan?
The owner found out she was sleeping with clients, so now she's been fired!
And now with Aimi-chan gone, my rank has gone up!
I see. What rank were you before?
Number two!
So then that means⑬
I made it to number one!
Hey, good for you.
I know! If you had slept with me, I would have gotten the axe too. Yikes, that was a close one!
Heh. You're one lucky girl.
And this means you don't have to spend that five million yen now.
I suppose not.
Come on, let's get back to the club. We need to celebrate a certain hostess becoming number one.
Yeah, let's go!
Kiryu-san, thank you so, so, much!
Hiya, Kiryu-san. What's up?
Riku, I have a proposal for you.
A what now?
I know someone who runs a club out in Kamurocho, and he's looking for hostesses.
If you'd be willing to help out, even on a temporary basis, it'd be a big help to him.
Kamurocho, huh?
So, what do you say? Want to come to Tokyo with me?
Sure! School's out on winter break and all anyhow. Look out, y'all! Riku-san's makin' her Tokyo debut!
Heh. Guess that settles that.
(Good. Seems I've convinced Riku. I should go back to Kamurocho and take her to Elise.)
Brr, it's cold! What's going on, Saejima-san?
Hey, I got somethin' to talk to ya about.
Oh? What is it?
I know a guy out in Kamurocho. He's lookin' for hostesses to work at his club.
Think ya could maybe work for him, just for a little bit? It'd be a big favor.
Kamurocho, you say?
Yeah. Well? Wanna come to Tokyo with me?
Why not? I've been out there before to earn money. There aren't many modeling jobs for me here, so this could be a lucrative opportunity!
Looks like it's all settled then.
(Okay, I've talked Kaguya into it. Guess we should go to Elise once we're back in Kamurocho.)
What's goin' on, Akiyama-san?
Hey there, Honoka-chan. Do you mind if I talk to you about something?
I run a cabaret club out in Kamurocho, and it's fallen on some hard times.
I'd love it if you'd be willing to help me out, just on a temporary basis.
Oh, wow. Kamurocho?
Well? Want to come with me to Tokyo?
Sure, okay! I was gonna head out there to look for a job anyhow. This'll be like a dry run!
Okay, then. Looks like it's a deal.
(Great. I got Honoka-chan to agree to my proposal. Let's go to Kamurocho and head back to Elise.)
Oh, Shinada-san. Is something wrong?
Hey, so, uh, Shion-chan? I've got something I kinda need to ask you.
So, I know someone who works out in Kamurocho, and he's looking for hostesses to work at his club.
It would just be a temporary thing, but it'd be a big help if you'd consider taking up a post there, Shion-chan.
Oh my. Kamurocho?

So, would you want to come to Tokyo with me?
Haha, nah, it's okay. Never min⑬
No, I can do it! In fact, I've always wanted to see what the clubs in Tokyo are like!
Whoa, for real? Well all right!
(Sweet. I convinced Shion-chan to go to Tokyo. When I go back to Kamurocho, we should head to Elise.)
All right, spit it out! Where is Subaru's hideout?
Ugh... It's in the Nagasu Tamura Building, on Nagasugawa Street.
Okay. Nagasu Tamura Building on Nagasugawa Street. That's where I'll find Riku.
(The clock's ticking. I need to hurry.)
(Damn it. I lost them.)
(Hm? Are those the guys I took down earlier?)
Ahh! It's that guy again!
Where is Subaru's hideout?
Ya won't get a peep outta me! And there ain't no way you're comin' out on top a second time. We're gonna stomp ya into the ground, son!
I really don't have time for this. So I'll make it quick.
I'm sorry you had to see that, Ta-chan. I'm ashamed of what I let myself fall for.
Are you... any better now?

How can I be? My boyfriend just completely screwed me over!
I've never felt this low in my life⑬it's like I'm polluted.
And there's nothing I can do to wash it away!
That's not true! Miyu-chan, there's nothing polluted about you. It's those two who are full of filth.
You're pure, Miyu-chan. Pure, and beautiful, and shining like a light in the darkness. I mean that with my heart.
Ta-chan... Thank you. I feel terrible for getting you into all this. I'm sorry.
Oh, no, you don't have to be. I didn't do anything special.

Anyway. I know it's not much of a condolence, but at least
you won't have to work so much anymore. Plus, you're free
of that self-serving asshole. Maybe it's for the best.
That is true... I just wish it didn't have to happen at the cost of my dream. Guess I won't be hearing wedding bells anytime soon, haha. But you know...
I might have found a new candidate for my next boyfriend. ♪
Could that possibly... be me?
Let's just say I'll give you some <Italic>extra steamy</Italic> service the next time you swing by.
Woohoo! Score!
Oh, and here's a little something as thanks. You take it.
Well, I guess I'll see you at the parlor, Ta-chan! Thanks again!
Hey, Miyu-chan, are you okay?
Oh, Ta-chan... I feel all... lightheaded.
How many hours are you working? You should talk to your manager and get them cut back.
The parlor isn't making me work. I asked for the extra shifts.
Did something... happen?
My new boyfriend. He owes money. I wanted to help him out, so I started working extra. I think I overdid it, though.
I see... Your boyfriend's a lucky guy.
He knows I work at a massage parlor, but he doesn't judge me for that. He even said he'd settle down with me once he's out of debt.
Then I can quit working like this... Maybe I can even be an ordinary wife one day.
That'd be nice. Listen, why don't you go back to the parlor and take a load off your feet, at least until you can walk home?
But I promised to meet my boyfriend. He has a loan payment due today, and I need to get him the money.
Why don't you get him to come get it, then?
Oh, please. I don't want him coming around there. You can understand that, can't you?

You said he wouldn't judge⑬ You know what, never mind.
Why don't I just deliver it for you?

Hmm, well, okay. I think I can trust you, Ta-chan.
If you really don't mind, please take this to him.
Here's the money, and his photo, so you know what he looks like.
Oh, so this is the lucky guy? Huh, can't say he's bad-looking...
Yuji should be waiting for me around the TV tower.
Yuji? Roger that. I'll go find him.
(Whoa, she can't even stand. Is she really okay?)
Wait... Ta-chan?
Huh? Oh, hey, Miyu-chan! How's it going? Haven't seen you since that article, I think it was.
If I had to be honest, I'd say I'm kind of run down.
Are you done for the day? You're the top draw at your parlor, so they must keep you busy.

Mm, that's not exactly it... But I have started working
extra shifts. It's kind of wearing me out.
That's not good. Want me to introduce you to a good acupuncture guy?
Hmm. I just might take you up on that sometime. Anyway, I have to go. I'm meeting someone right now.
Sure. I'm looking forward to our next juicy article!
(Miyu-chan just got off work and all, but even so, she looked really wiped out. Hope she's not grinding too hard out there...)
Damn it! How the hell'd I lose to this chump!?
Hey. So what are your intentions for Miyu-chan?
She's working her heart out for you, because she believes you and her are going to tie the knot one day.
Heh, you've got to be joking. What kind of idiot would tie himself down to a meat masseuse?
Sure, we had our fun, but that's all it is. A kind word here and there is all it takes to keep her bringing in the bacon.
But I'm not crazy enough to marry a woman who spreads her legs for a living. I can barely stand touching that tramp, let alone the thought of wasting my future on her!
So... Is that how it really is?
Miyu-chan?
What a fool I was to get taken in by you and your cheap lies!
Miyu-chan, you've got it all wrong. It's just...
I've really hit rock bottom, haven't I? I'm so... disappointed in myself.
Miyu-chan!
Heheh... Well, I guess the cash you just gave me can be my severance package.
If you want to stay in one piece, you might want to pay back all the money she gave you.
You're kidding, right? Why the hell would I do that?
Yeah! You won't see any of that back! She gave it of her own free will!
I see. Well, let's find out what her co-workers have to say about that. The bodyguard there is built like a pro wrestler, you know.
He's real good at debt collecting. The punching and kicking kind, that is. If I were you, I'd make paying that money back a priority.
Hey, wait a minute...
Miyu-chan is the number one girl at her job. They'll do whatever it takes to make her happy.
No... No way!
And don't think that just paying back the principal will cut it. She's gonna need compensation on top of that, scumbag!
Gah! Goddamn it...
There you are, Yuji!  Did you finish up your little errand?
Yeah, all good now. Let's go drink up a storm!
What the...!?
Tch. You still hanging around?
Who's that girl? Don't tell me you're cheating on Miyu-chan!
What's with this guy, Yuji?
Nothing. Let's ditch this loser.
Miyu-chan's slaving away to help pay off your debt! Or did you forget!?
Didn't you promise you were gonna settle down with her...?
Haha... That will never happen, because Yuji's marrying me. Who'd marry some bimbo who works at a massage parlor?
...I see what's going on here. So this girl here's in on it too. The two of you are just using Miyu-chan for her money!
I know this isn't fair to Miyu-chan. But you'd better not tell her. You know it'd break her little heart.
Yeah, and cut off your cash flow!

You're starting to get on my nerves, man. Want me to chop
your ass up?
I may not look it, but I can hold my own in a brawl because <Italic>I</Italic> know karate. Even busting out a simple kata routine gets Miyu-chan super wet.
You don't say? Then maybe if I give you a good ass-kicking, Miyu-chan will see you for the slimy little runt you are.
Let's see if you can back those words up, you old shithead!
(Hmm... Guess Yuji-kun isn't here yet. Or, wait, is that him?)
Uh, are you Yuji-kun?
Huh? Who the hell are you?
I'm here on behalf of Miyu-chan. She isn't feeling too hot today, so she asked me to bring this money over to you.
Oh yeah? Sweet! That's great!
Okay, I guess that's that.
Yeah, you saved my ass.
Hold on. Aren't you gonna ask about Miyu-chan? She's too sick to even make it out to see you, you know.
Yeah, but she's a tough old bird, so to speak⑬I'm sure she's holding up. I'll send her an email or something. Anyway, later!
(Is that guy really Miyu-chan's boyfriend? This is not the kind of behavior I expected.)
The fuck!? Who the hell are you guys!?
Want another round?
Tch! Come on, let's get out of here!
Hey, hold on! Pick up your cigarette first!
Sorry! I'll get it!

Appreciate you lendin' a hand. That was some fine work you
did!

Heh, I could say the same about you. Seems you could have
done just fine without me!

Heh, sorry you had to see me lose my temper like that. I
just can't stand to see such inconsiderate behavior.

People gotta think about others, as well. No double-dippin'
into the sauce after you take a bite. We all might want
some, you know?
Double-dipping into the sauce? I think you might've lost me.

Oh, I should introduce myself. I'm Ueyama. I'm the chairman
of Kushikatsu Daruma.

Ah, the fried pork skewer place. That explains the sauce
analogy.

Oh, I'm Akiyama of Sky Finance. I just set up a branch in
Sotenbori.

No kiddin'? Then I might be in touch if I ever need a
helpin' hand!
I'm always ready to hear people out.

Seems like fate could be at work here. You oughta stop by
the restaurant if you get a chance.
Hopefully I'll have our new menu together by then.
New menu?

I've been rackin' my brain to come up with one. I was
startin' to get frustrated, and then that idiot tossed his
butt into the street.

Makes the blood boil, don't it? I couldn't control my
temper.

You mean all that fuss was you taking out your frustrations
on him?

Well, maybe I was a little pricklier than usual. But never
mind that! Hahaha!
